d: Jet black hair is styled into two low, fluffy pigtails with messy, uneven bangs and a few stray strands sticking upward, held back by a thin blue headband. Large, downturned purple eyes convey a timid, melancholic expression on a youthful, adolescent face. The build is slender with a soft, petite frame. The outfit consists of a dark purple dress with a high neckline and a deep red scarf tied at the chest with a gold decorative brooch. Long, pointed elven ears protrude from the sides of the head.
